_about: Ground truth extracted from the Lost Cities jars by disassembling every mcjty class with javap and reading the mod's own constants. Codec keys come from each fieldOf and optionalFieldOf call. Profile keys come from each Configuration.get call, whose count this matches exactly, and 'section' is the config category the key is registered under, which is also the JSON object it must sit in inside a profile file. Regenerate rather than hand-edit.
